01

What We Built

StreetLens combines camera-assisted address lookup, property insights, notes and a shortlist. Insights compares bedroom groups; Analysis, Compare, Market and Suburb provide deeper views. [1]

The agent’s journey

  1. Notice a building
  2. Take a picture
  3. Confirm the address
  4. Review insights
  5. Decide whether to research further
  6. Capture notes & shortlist

Technical stack

Free, in-house address lookup first; paid property data only once the address is confirmed, cached and shared by every user.

02

Why It Matters

On the way to the next inspection, an agent spots a for-sale sign—or a building that could suit a client. There’s an opportunity to explore, but no time to stop and research.

StreetLens is designed for that moment: point the camera, confirm the address and review key market insights within 30 seconds. Decide whether it deserves a closer look, then save a note while the property and the client’s needs are still fresh. [1, 3]

Make the call on the street.

Is this worth investigating for my buyer? Bring the first assessment into the gap between inspections, and keep the address and observations together for follow-up.

Come back to a report, not a research task.

In the planned workflow, the agent sends the address and notes to an AI Research Agent, then continues to the next inspection. Research happens in the meantime; back at the office, the agent reads the report instead of starting from scratch.

04

How It Works

Address lookup uses GPS, bearing, tilt and a tap at the building’s base. Automatic visual building recognition is not implemented. [1]

Address resolution

G-NAF provides address candidates; Google Places supports typed searches. Microburbs resolves the selected address to the final property ID. A building match does not identify an individual unit. [1] [7]

Application & data

Expo / React Native, FastAPI, Postgres caching and R2 photo storage. Bedroom filters use loaded data; dwelling-type filtering falls back to all kinds when necessary. Devices currently share the scan list without sign-in. [1] [8]

05

Limitations & Next Steps

Limitations

  • GPS, compass and camera calibration can shift address candidates.
  • A building match does not establish an individual unit.
  • Sparse or stale comparable sales limit the assessment.
  • Device compatibility, voice typing and iOS delivery remain unverified or pending.

Next steps

  • Field-test address accuracy and calibrate more phones.
  • Verify notes, shortlist persistence and market calculations.
  • Add iOS delivery, usage limits and spend caps.
  • Explore automatic building detection and client matching.

AI research · planned

Send address + notes → generate report → read at the office

“Send to Research Agent” is display-only in this version. No request is sent and no report is generated. [1, 3]
